final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT telescref AS c1, AVG(modindex) AS c2 FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS c1 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c2 - s2.c1 AS c3 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.c1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c2 > s2.c1), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS c1 FROM s3) SELECT s3.c1, s3.c2, s3.c3, s3.c2 / NULLIF(s4.c1, 0) AS ratio FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.c1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
